This is the first tagged release of Goobers — an open, self-hosted
platform for running an AI workforce against your repositories and
backlog. Instead of an open-ended prompt, you define a team of roles
(a gaggle) and the workflow, permissions, checks, retry limits, and
human handoffs that govern its work.

This release ships a single Go binary for macOS (signed and
notarized), Linux, and Windows (unsigned — see "Signing posture" in
the release docs), an install script, and the guided onboarding
quickstart with the reference `implementation` workflow (issue →
implementation → review → CI → PR).
